instructions: Surveys FAQ only. Mentorship surveys are separate. Use the paired Word document for detail. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour across all modules.

faqs.question: What are Surveys on TEFConnect?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneurs open assigned programme surveys, accept Terms, answer multi-step questions, and submit. Mentors do not have Surveys in their side menu.

faqs.question: Are Mentorship surveys the same as Surveys?
faqs.answer: No. Mentorship Start Survey is separate. Surveys menu is for entrepreneur programme surveys.

faqs.question: How do I open Surveys?
faqs.answer: Sign in → side menu Surveys. Incomplete profiles go to My Profile first.

faqs.question: What do I see on the Surveys list?
faqs.answer: Survey Name, Programme, Submitted Date & Time, Survey Status, Action. Filters: All/Not Started/In Progress/Completed. Search on current page. 10 per page.

faqs.question: How do I start a survey?
faqs.answer: Start → agree I agree to the Terms and Conditions → Accept & Start Programme. Decline & Exit returns to list. Already accepted terms may skip to questions.

faqs.question: How do I answer and submit?
faqs.answer: Answer required questions → Next to save/continue → Submit on last step → Survey submitted successfully → back to list. Survey Progress shows %.

faqs.question: Can I view a submitted survey?
faqs.answer: When View is available, open read-only answers. Previous/Next if multiple steps. Empty answers: No answer provided.

faqs.question: Can I go back while filling?
faqs.answer: Authenticated fill offers Next/Submit, not Previous. Guest drop-off surveys allow Previous. Next saves the step.

faqs.question: What files can I upload?
faqs.answer: Formats from the survey; defaults often jpg/jpeg/png/pdf; doc/docx may appear when allowed. No fixed max size shown in Surveys UI.

faqs.question: What is a drop-off survey link?
faqs.answer: Email/link with token, not side menu. Start Survey if needed → answer → Thank you. Invalid/expired links show errors and may offer Go to portal login.

faqs.question: What statuses might I see?
faqs.answer: Filters: All/Not Started/In Progress/Completed. Rows may also show Submitted/Approved/Rejected.

faqs.question: What can I not do in Surveys?
faqs.answer: Cannot create templates; no Save & Exit beyond Next; no Previous on authenticated fill; no countdown timer UI; mentors no menu; Mentorship surveys elsewhere.

faqs.question: Why can’t I start or open a survey?
faqs.answer: Complete profile first; agree to terms; use View if only viewable; drop-off token may be invalid/expired.

faqs.question: No surveys found.
faqs.answer: Empty list message when you have no surveys in the current filter/page.

faqs.question: You must agree to the terms…
faqs.answer: Tick I agree to the Terms and Conditions before Accept & Start Programme.

faqs.question: This field is required.
faqs.answer: Answer all required questions before Next/Submit.

faqs.question: Please answer all required questions.
faqs.answer: Validation failed on the step — complete required fields.

faqs.question: Invalid survey link.
faqs.answer: mapping id/token missing or invalid.

faqs.question: Survey unavailable.
faqs.answer: Guest survey cannot be loaded; Go to portal login may be offered.

faqs.question: This survey link is invalid or has expired.
faqs.answer: Token unauthorized/expired.

faqs.question: Survey not found.
faqs.answer: Guest survey mapping not found.

faqs.question: Viewing submitted responses.
faqs.answer: Read-only mode label when viewing submitted/read-only survey answers.

faqs.question: Start vs View.
faqs.answer: canStart shows Start; otherwise canView shows View survey.

faqs.question: Search not finding a survey on later pages.
faqs.answer: List search is on the current page of results only.

faqs.question: What question types exist?
faqs.answer: Text, rich text, date, dropdown, radio/yes-no/MCQ, checkbox, multi-select, file/image/document.

faqs.question: Survey started successfully.
faqs.answer: Toast after Accept & Start Programme succeeds.

faqs.question: Survey submitted successfully.
faqs.answer: Toast after Submit succeeds.

faqs.question: Thank you after drop-off submit.
faqs.answer: Guest success message with Survey submitted successfully.

faqs.question: Do mentors have Surveys?
faqs.answer: No Surveys item in mentor side menu.

faqs.question: Where is Mentorship Start Survey?
faqs.answer: My Mentorship or My Mentee List — see Mentorship document.

faqs.question: Already submitted drop-off survey.
faqs.answer: May open read-only depending on mapping status.

faqs.question: No options available for this question.
faqs.answer: Shown when a choice question has no options/unknown type.

faqs.question: Submitted Date & Time blank.
faqs.answer: Shows — when no date is available.

faqs.question: Surveys without completed profile.
faqs.answer: Redirected to My Profile before protected Surveys pages.

faqs.question: Can I create a survey?
faqs.answer: No. Members only respond to assigned surveys.

faqs.question: Draft Save & Exit?
faqs.answer: Not available beyond Next saving the current step.

faqs.question: Start Survey vs Accept & Start Programme.
faqs.answer: Drop-off accept CTA is Start Survey; authenticated terms CTA is Accept & Start Programme.

faqs.question: Approved/Rejected on list.
faqs.answer: May appear as status badges even if filter chips are All/Not Started/In Progress/Completed.

faqs.question: Progress bar meaning.
faqs.answer: Survey Progress percentage 0–100 for the survey fill.

faqs.question: Language on drop-off pages.
faqs.answer: Guest chrome includes language selection with TEFConnect branding.

faqs.question: Countdown timer for survey window?
faqs.answer: Not shown in this Surveys UI.

faqs.question: Pagination text.
faqs.answer: Showing {start}-{end} of {total} Results.

faqs.question: Decline & Exit.
faqs.answer: Leaves terms and returns to Surveys list without starting.

faqs.question: Enter here / Select placeholders.
faqs.answer: Shown on text/select fields where offered.
